questions.question:
After interchanging the given two signs and two numbers, what will be the value of the given equation?

+ and -, 7 and 9 ; 8 × 7 + 9 ÷ 1 - 5
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Given equation is : 8 × 7 + 9 ÷ 1 - 5

After interchanging the two numbers 7 and 9 and two signs + and - the equation is as follows : 8 × 9 - 7 ÷ 1 + 5

= 8 × 9 - __**7 ÷ 1**__ + 5

= __**8 × 9**__ - 7 + 5

= __**72**__ - 7 __**+ 5**__

= __**77 - 7**__

= **70**

Hence, the correct answer is **"70".**

questions.question: If 21st February 2005 was a Sunday, then what would be the day of the week on 21st February 2007?
questions.solution:
We know that: 

In an ordinary year, there are 365 days and on dividing 365 by 7,

 
• We get remainder = 1 so this extra one day is taken as odd day.

Similarly, in an leap year, there are 366 days and on dividing 366 by 7,

 
• we get remainder = 2 so this extra two days is taken as odd days.

Thus, the remainder, which we get after dividing the number of days by 7 is considered as odd days.

Given 21st February 2005 was a Sunday.

Since 2005 is non-leap year.

 
• **Number of odd days from year 21st**** February** **2005 to 21st**** February** **2007 = (1 + 1) = 2 Odd days.**

∴ On 21st February 2005, **it was Sunday + 2 = Tuesday.**

∴ Here, 'Tuesday' is day of the week on 21st February 2007.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Tuesday".**

In Row 2 – P, Q, R, S and T are seated and all of them are facing the north.

Thus, each person is facing another person from the other row.

B is sitting third to the right of A. P is facing an immediate neighbour of A. R is sitting third to the left of P. D is sitting second to the left of the person who is facing T. D is not sitting at any of the extreme ends of the row. C is facing Q.

questions.question:
This question consists of a pair of words which have a certain relationship to each other. Select the pair which does NOT have the same relationship.

Allure : Repulse

1) Creation : Destruction

2) Fluctuate : Stabilize

3) Immense : Huge

4) Notion : Reality
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **Opposites**.

Here,

Allure : Repulse → **Allure** is the opposite of **Repulse**.

Similarly,

Creation : Destruction → **Creation** is the opposite of **Destruction**.

Fluctuate : Stabilize → **Fluctuate** is the opposite of **Stabilize**.

Notion : Reality → **Notion** is the opposite of **Reality**.

However,

Immense : Huge → **Immense** is not the opposite of **Huge**; they are synonyms.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

Jay, Dev, Lakshmi, Hina, and Atul are each going to the same city but each of them reaches the city at different times. Lakshmi reaches only after Jay and Dev just before Atul.

Who among the following reaches the city first?
questions.solution:

Jay > Lakshmi

**2) Dev just before Atul.**

Dev > Atul

**By combing 1 and 2,**

Jay > Lakshmi > Hina > Dev > Atul

**OR**

Jay > Lakshmi > Dev > Atul > Hina 

So, 'Jay' reaches the city first.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Jay"**.

The average of attendance of a school for first four days of a week is 140 and for first five days is 160. How many students are present on the fifth day?
questions.solution:
Average attendance for first four days = 140

Total attendance for first four days = 140 × 4 = 560

Average attendance for first five days = 160

Total attendance for first five days = 160 × 5 = 800

Therefore, attendance on fifth day = 800 – 560 = 240

Hence, ‘240’ is the correct answer.

questions.question: A cube of side 125 cm is painted red on all the faces and then cut into smaller cubes of sides 25 cm each. Find the number of smaller cubes having at least two faces painted.
questions.solution:
__**Given:**__

Length of the side of the big cube = 125 cm.

Length of the side of the smaller cube = 25 cm.

__**Formula:**__

A cube is a three-dimensional figure with 8 corners, 6 surfaces, and 12 edges (sides).

If a cube is painted on all of its surfaces with the same colour, and then divided into smaller cubes of equal size, then the number of smaller cubes so obtained will be calculated as follows:

__
 
• Number of cubes with no face painted = (n - 2)³
 
• Number of cubes with one face painted = 6(n - 2)²
 
• Number of cubes with two faces painted = 12(n - 2)
 
• Number of cubes with three faces painted = 8(Always)

 where n = No. of parts of each side = Length of the side of larger cube ÷ length of the side of the smaller cube

**Calculation:__**

n = 125 ÷ 25 = 5

⇒ n - 2 = 3

Number of smaller cubes having at least two faces painted

= total no. of cubes - (no. of cubes with no face painted + no. of cubes with only one face painted)

= 125 - (3³ + 6 × 3²)

= 125 - (27 + 54)

= 125 - 81

= 44

Hence, 44 is the correct answer.
